title: Cellular diagonal on Forcey-Loday multiplihedra with operadic bimodule compatibility and an explicit signed tensor-product formula
difficulty_reason: One integrated H2 construction remains after the named AD/Doker generalized-permutahedron projection, LA21 fiber-polytope/hyperplane and determinant methods, and the already retained JEP142 associahedral operad/diagonal inputs. The authored work joins colored facet coordinate blocks, a good-vector transfer through a nonorthogonal projection, the explicit B/Q normal-cone encoding with different nth coordinates and four strict intersection tests, and colored admissible-edge/shared-edge sign permutations under fixed cellular orientations, uniformly in arity. This is more than fixed-arity coefficient substitution. Existence under general theory, transition uniqueness, and ordinary strong-monoidal transport are not counted again; explicit signs refine this same object rather than supplying a second H3.

selected_primary_statements.text:
\begin{prop}
Let $m$ and $n$ be two positive integers.
\begin{enumerate}
\item\label{prop0.2.1} The shuffle of an $m$-permutahedron by an $n$-associahedron is an \linebreak
\emph{$(m,n)$-multiplihedron}, whose faces are encoded by
\emph{$m$-painted $n$-trees},
\item\label{prop0.2.2} The shuffle of an $m$-associahedron by an $n$-associahedron is an
\emph{$(m,n)$-cons\-trainahedron}, whose faces are encoded by
\emph{$(m,n)$-cotrees},
\item\label{prop0.2.3} The shuffle of an $m$-anti-associahedron by an $n$-associahedron is an \linebreak
\emph{$(m,n)$-biassociahedron}, whose faces are encoded by
\emph{$(m,n)$-bitrees}.
\end{enumerate}
\end{prop}

editorial_notes: 全文 operad 指 non-symmetric（173、810）；M-infinity 是 (A-infinity,A-infinity)-operadic bimodule。不可把 M diagonal 改叫普通 operad diagonal。
K_n 在 R^(n-1) 中维数 n-2；J_n 在 R^(n-1) 中维数 n-1，J_1 约定为一点。n 是树叶/线性图顶点数，不能与 polytope 维数互换。
v_i >= 2v_(i+1) 且末坐标 >0；单纯坐标递减只够在 927-928 的边方向上判正，不能代替整个投影论证的 good 条件。
正定向的 v 与胞腔的定向基是两类资料，均保留。K 顶胞腔用 e_1-e_(j+1)，1<=j<=n-2；J 顶胞腔用 -e_j，1<=j<=n-1；其余面以 left-levelwise 复合诱导。
D(n) 的等基数、不交与最小元属于 I 条件均按 1138 原式保留；蓝 B 第 n 位 0、Q 第 n 位 1，四不等式的严格方向按 1149-1152 保留，不补修原式。
K 用 |N|+|Nprime|=n 及 top<=bottom；M 用 |mono(N)|+|mono(Nprime)|=n-1 及 Theorem 2 四条件，不把 mono 换为总 nest 数。
K 的 sigma 含 -1 移位；M 的 sigma 无 -1，且分共享边时 monochrome/bicolored 的不同情形；均有 (-1)^|Ad(N) intersection Ad(Nprime)| * sgn(sigma)。
M⊗M 的双模结构依赖所选 K/A-infinity diagonal 的拉回，不能把两个 diagonal 当成彼此无关的任意映射。
4.25 排除严格 composition compatibility；4.26 给 up-to-homotopy 性质。本文特定 diagonal 非余交换，任意 diagonal 均非余交换在 1921 仍为猜想。一般高阶相干的 homotopy symmetric monoidal 结构留未来，不能写成已构成。
F:A_1->A_2，G:C_2->C_1，所得 Hom(C_1,A_1)->Hom(C_2,A_2)；保留 coalgebra 一侧的反变方向。
